text:
maria_support: FYI acme reported their CSV export (daily_rollup) has empty rows for specific days even though the console shows tokens. They need a clean export for invoice reconciliation. Pasting their excerpt below.

maria_support: CSV snippet from customer: 
```
date,customer_id,tokens_generated
2026-02-20,acme_inc,0
2026-02-21,acme_inc,0
2026-02-22,acme_inc,12450
```

maria_support: They say the console shows ~18.2k tokens across 20-22 but CSV totals 12.45k.

vijay_eng: OK can you attach the raw export job id and the s3 path? also which export (daily_rollup CSV v2 or raw-events API) did they use?

maria_support: customer provided s3 link: s3://exports/redwood/acme/2026-02/daily-rollup-20260222.csv (they used our CSV daily_rollup). I ran the raw-events API for the same range and got ~18.2k which matches console.

ben_ops: I pulled the rollup job logs for that day. Seeing something interesting: rollup job runs per-shard hourly and writes a zero-marker for day shards with no events at cutoff. Later a backfill inserts events but the daily rollup writer doesn't overwrite the zero marker. Log snippet:
```
[2026-02-21T02:00:03Z] rollup-writer shard=3 date=2026-02-20 wrote marker has_data=false rows=0
[2026-02-21T06:11:20Z] backfill-runner shard=3 date=2026-02-20 inserted events=4300
[2026-02-21T07:00:01Z] rollup-writer shard=3 date=2026-02-20 skipped overwrite because has_data_marker_exists
```

vijay_eng: that matches my mental model. The daily_rollup pipeline currently treats presence of a marker as authoritative and avoids expensive rewrites. Backfill path doesn't flip the marker. So CSV shows 0 while raw-events and dashboard (which sums events) show true counts.

sara_billing: What's the delta for ACME's invoice? they need a corrected export for accounting.

maria_support: Customer reported invoices for 2026-02 net difference ~5,750 tokens (they provided invoice id INV-ACME-202602).

ben_ops: quick calc from logs: backfill inserted 4,300 for 2026-02-20 and 1,450 for 2026-02-21 => 5,750 total. Numbers line up.

vijay_eng: repro steps for eng:
1) run raw-events query for customer+date range to get authoritative token counts (SQL below)
2) fetch daily_rollup CSV for same date range from s3
3) compare sum(tokens) between raw-events and CSV

SQL to run:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as day, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme_inc' AND event_time >= '2026-02-20' AND event_time < '2026-02-23'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```

vijay_eng: short-term remediation: we can run a targeted rollup re-run for acme for dates 2026-02-20 and 2026-02-21 that overwrites markers (idempotent write). long-term: patch rollup-writer to check event count and allow overwrite if new events exist.

ben_ops: I can trigger the targeted re-run now (takes ~15-30m for a single customer). Will post s3 path when done.

maria_support: please do. Customer wants corrected CSV asap and a note we will reconcile their invoice. They asked for a one-off corrected export and confirmation that billing will reflect corrected totals.

sara_billing: once corrected CSV is available send to billing@ and cc the customer. We will issue credit if invoice already paid. Also need list of affected invoices (INV-ACME-202602).

ingest-bot: backfill-job-1798 STARTED shard=3 target_dates=[2026-02-20,2026-02-21] triggered_by=ben_ops

deploy-bot: rollup-rewriter v1.2.3 queued for run (patch to allow overwrite when backfill > 0)

ben_ops: re-run done. New CSV at s3://exports/redwood/acme/2026-02/daily-rollup-20260222-corrected.csv. Contents preview: 
```
2026-02-20,acme_inc,4300
2026-02-21,acme_inc,1450
2026-02-22,acme_inc,12450
```

maria_support: forwarded corrected CSV and apologies to customer. They acknowledged receipt and asked for root cause.

vijay_eng: root cause summary for postmortem (short): daily_rollup writes a has_data marker at cutoff to avoid rewrites; backfill runner later inserts events but doesn't flip marker or trigger rollup re-run. Result: exported CSV can show 0 for days where events arrived after cutoff. Impact: undercount in CSV exports and any downstream invoice exports that rely solely on daily_rollup CSV.

vijay_eng: action items: (1) patch rollup-writer to make marker semantics updatable or make backfill trigger idempotent rewrite (2) add a nightly consistency check that compares raw-events aggregates to rollup aggregates per-customer and flags deltas > threshold (3) ops to run one-off reconciliations for affected customers and issue corrected exports/billing adjustments.

sara_billing: assign priority P1 for billing impact. I'll coordinate credits.

maria_support: thanks everyone. Customer satisfied with corrected CSV and provisional credit. Closing once billing confirms. :thumbsup:
